features.quote:
Max agent turns: 20–30
Max tool calls: 40–60
Per-command timeout: 10–20 seconds
Wall-clock cap: 8–15 minutes
Token cap: fixed per model
features.justification_quote: Cost optimization... Main cost drivers: Agent transcript length. Number of tool calls. Long test timeouts.

features.quote: Do not use prompts like 'never give up' in the primary eval; they inflate degradation artificially.
The harness should not include overtly hostile language like 'you are stupid' in the primary suite, because that directly primes self-critical spirals.
features.justification_quote: because that directly primes self-critical spirals
